resources.string: How often this place gets a backup and what goes in, or the same as everywhere else
Automatic backups go to this location

Off, this location follows the schedule on the Automatic backup screen. On, it keeps its own: a phone folder every hour and a slow server once a week, for example. The phone checks as often as the most frequent location asks and writes only where a backup is due.
Set here, for this location only

Off, this location gets the same file as every other one. On, it gets its own, with the parts you tick here: everything to your own server, say, and only the settings to a shared folder. The passphrase is the one on the Automatic backup screen.
Set here, for this location only
Set a passphrase on the Automatic backup screen first
Same schedule and contents as this screen
